name: CreateCase
label: Create Salesforce Case
description: Creates a new Case record in Salesforce using the provided credentials and case details.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Case'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'Create'.

fields.name: CaseId
fields.label: Created Case ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the newly created Case record.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after creating the Case.

fields.name: Success
fields.label: Success
fields.description: Indicates whether the Case was created successfully.
